description:
Coastal Network

A Minecraft Network Built for the Community.

Welcome to Coastal Network, a Minecraft Bedrock network bringing together classic Minecraft experiences, competitive gameplay, and a friendly community.

Built from the ground up with custom features, unique gameplay systems, and a focus on performance, Coastal Network offers something for every type of Minecraft player. Whether you're looking to compete in BedWars, build your own island in Skyblock, or simply enjoy Minecraft with friends, there's always something to do.

Our Gamemodes

BedWars — Defend your bed, eliminate opposing teams, and compete in fast-paced matches.

Skyblock — Build your island from nothing, develop farms, earn money, and climb the leaderboards.

Prisons — Mine, earn money, progress through ranks, and work your way to the top.

Duels — Challenge other players and put your PvP skills to the test.

Township Survival — Enjoy a community-focused survival experience where you can build, explore, and progress.

Rotating Minigames — Experience classic Minecraft minigames, including Spleef, TNT Run, and Elytra Racing, featuring nostalgic Xbox 360-inspired experiences.

The BedWars Pro League

For competitive players, Coastal Network features its own BedWars Pro League, bringing organized competitive matches and tournaments to the community.

Why Play Coastal Network?

Custom-developed features and gameplay systems.

Multiple gamemodes for casual and competitive players.

Classic Minecraft minigames and nostalgic maps.

Regular updates, improvements, and new content.

Competitive events, tournaments, and leaderboards.

An active community with dedicated staff.

A dedicated Player Portal for managing your account, applications, and support requests.

Coastal Network is constantly growing, with new features and improvements shaped by community feedback.

Join Coastal Network today and become part of our community!
